BY THE TIME THE COUNTY COMMISSION ACTS UPON IT, THE ORDINANCE HAS ALREADY BEEN BAKED AND ALREADY SAYS, AT LEAST IN THAT SITUATION --

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THE COMMISSIONER -- COMMISSIONER COHEN LITERALLY JUST LAST WEEK ASKED THEIR STAFF TO START WORKING ON THIS. SO I THINK THIS IS TIMELY THAT WE ASK OUR STAFF TO COORDINATE WITH THEM. HE MADE THE MOTION AT HILLSBOROUGH COUNTY COMMISSION MEETING TO HAVE IT OPEN SO THAT THE TEMPLE TERRACE AND PLANT CITY AND CITY OF TAMPA CAN BE ADOPTED INTO THAT ORDINANCE.

segments.speaker: MARTIN SHELBY
segments.text: THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: VERY GOOD.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: I HAVE A MOTION AND SECOND. ALL IN FAVOR? AYE.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: I HAVE A MOTION TO RECEIVE AND FILE FROM COUNCILMAN MANISCALCO. SECOND FROM COUNCILMAN MIRANDA. ALL THOSE IN FAVOR AYE. OPPOSED. AYES HAVE IT. [ SOUNDING GAVEL ] WE'RE ADJOURNED.
